recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s studio portrait of a male vocalist, featuring a three-quarter length pose with a hand-to-chin gesture, set against a neutral, textured studio backdrop with flush-left serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center facing the camera
Typography anchored to the upper-left quadrant
Horizontal rule separating primary title from tracklist
Muted, desaturated color palette emphasizing teal and olive tones
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting with minimal shadows
High-waisted blue trousers paired with a dark v-neck sweater
Clean-shaven face with styled, side-parted hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hand-to-chin gesture serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the arm to the lap, then sweep up to the text block on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the upper left and top margins to accommodate text and branding.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy/teal sweater providing dark value
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white shirt collar and cuffs for highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white collar and dark sweater.

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by a thin horizontal line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of the same serif family to maintain mid-century formal consistency.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo in upper right
Serial number in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with high contrast and sharp serifs typical of the era.
Provides the traditional, authoritative feel of 1960s record labels.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a 1960s male singer in a dark teal v-neck sweater over a white collared shirt, sitting with hand to chin, against a mottled olive-grey background. Soft lighting, film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps serif text in the upper left quadrant. Use a large font for the name and a smaller font for a list below it. Separate the two sections with a thin horizontal line. Add a small circular emblem in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette muted and vintage?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the primary title
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and track titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horizontal line is perfectly straight and thin.
Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the all-caps styling for all text elements.
Confirm the background has a painterly, non-uniform texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Left-Aligned Serif Typography + Horizontal Rule + Muted 60s Palette
